RETROSPECTIVE ARCHITECTURE DECISION · 11 OCTOBER 2026

ADR-0015: One portable repository and verified documentation navigation

Status

Accepted; consolidated lab implemented

Context

The monitor and supporting designs were split across two evolving projects and absolute hosted links.

Decision

Consolidate source, fixtures, diagrams, design builders, ADRs, model results, tests and container helpers in one private Git repository. Build a local portal with portable links and verify referenced files/fragments and deployment claims.

Alternatives

Keep separate downloads with drift; copy only rendered pages without editable source.

Consequences

Generated content is reproducible. Preserve source provenance and mark historical documents. The canonical GitHub repository is paulcull/sovereign-federation-lab; Sites records historical provenance. Optional export to another new repository needs an authenticated CLI.

Evidence

docs/source-provenance.json; scripts/build.py; scripts/verify.py; scripts/release.py

Gate

Clean rebuild, navigation/asset checks, source archive integrity and exact committed-source packaging.
